mechanism: Calcium carbonate may reduce denosumab absorption and efficacy as a monoclonal antibody, though the primary concern is ensuring adequate calcium supplementation is maintained during denosumab therapy to prevent hypocalcemia.
action: Monitor serum calcium levels closely; administer calcium carbonate at least 2 hours apart from denosumab if possible, and ensure adequate calcium intake is maintained throughout denosumab treatment to mitigate hypocalcemia risk.
